canDoYue: 你識講刻字、名首字母、日期、字體、字數上限、手續費同三日後取，並核對串法。
canDoEn: Ask for an engraving with initials and a date, choose a plain font within the character limit, and check the spelling before a three-day fee.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: I would like one short engraving of our wedding date on this silver bracelet as a gift.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想喺呢條銀手鏈刻一段短嘅結婚日期，當禮物。
dialogue.say: I would like one short engraving of our wedding date on this silver bracelet as a gift.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: We can add that engraving for you, and each initial must fit the character limit here.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋可以幫你加刻字，每個名首字母都要符合呢度嘅字數上限。
dialogue.say: We can add that engraving for you, and each initial must fit the character limit here.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Can you please use a plain font for each initial, and is there an extra fee?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以用工整字體刻每個名首字母，有冇額外手續費？
dialogue.say: Can you please use a plain font for each initial, and is there an extra fee?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The plain font is free of any charge, and the extra fee starts after twelve characters.
dialogue.glossYue: 工整字體唔使加錢，超過十二個字先收額外手續費。
dialogue.say: The plain font is free of any charge, and the extra fee starts after twelve characters.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Please check the spelling of that date before you cut the small engraving into the metal.
dialogue.glossYue: 刻落金屬之前，請先檢查嗰個日期嘅串法。
dialogue.say: Please check the spelling of that date before you cut the small engraving into the metal.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: I will check the spelling with you first, and the engraving is ready in three days.
dialogue.glossYue: 我先同你核對串法，刻字三日後可以取。
dialogue.say: I will check the spelling with you first, and the engraving is ready in three days.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Will the fee stay the same if the spelling is right and the font stays plain?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果串法啱，字體又保持工整，手續費會唔會一樣？
dialogue.say: Will the fee stay the same if the spelling is right and the font stays plain?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The fee stays the same for you, and three days is enough when the spelling is right.
dialogue.glossYue: 手續費維持一樣，串法啱嘅話三日就夠。
dialogue.say: The fee stays the same for you, and three days is enough when the spelling is right.
